Azure is now certified for SAP products, including SAP Business Suite, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA Developer Edition. This means your business can deploy these solutions using Azure's reliable and secure cloud infrastructure platform. You'll have full support from Microsoft and SAP, including access to the SAP Cloud Appliance Library tool .

Use your existing SAP licenses to deploy SAP software on Azure. Standard purchase models, pricing, and terms apply for Azure services. Check out SAP on Azure to learn more.
